name: Johnny Terror

tenures.source: A recurring associate of Shane Matthews, first seen partying with him on a beach interview (Saturday Night Slam & Monday Night Live, 5/27, msg_id xTKN8qgxBJQJ), later a co-host of Straight Talk (msg_id s8l2m41G87IJ); implicated in the corrupt officiating of the vacant World Heavyweight title battle royal, when special referee Scorpion "shook hands with Johnny Terror and Matthews" after the finish (The AEWA Report 11/21, msg_id SEv4igIr7GAJ, already served).

caption: A manager and broadcaster allied with Shane Matthews, implicated in the corrupt officiating that handed Matthews the vacant World Heavyweight title.

name: Scorpion

tenures.source: Special referee for the 26-man battle royal to fill the vacant World Heavyweight title on Wednesday Night Rumble (11/20); the fed's own newsletter reports he "pulled down the top rope, causing Heavy Metal to get eliminated," handing the title to Shane Matthews, then "shook hands with Johnny Terror and Matthews" and left with them (The AEWA Report 11/21, msg_id SEv4igIr7GAJ, already served).

caption: The special referee whose corrupt officiating -- pulling down the top rope to eliminate Heavy Metal -- handed Shane Matthews the vacant AEWA World Heavyweight title.

name: The Crazy Canuck

tenures.source: A running storyline across the fed's own autumn newsletters: snapped and chair-shot both Primal Fear and "Superman" Mike Stewart after months of being overlooked (The AEWA Report 10/22, msg_id HOSViH5uul8J, already served), then vomited on national television after a Primal Fear attack and was hospitalized (The AEWA Report 11/4 and 11/24, msg_ids 46SnnrzDuAgJ and -lxI2XUWUtMJ, already served); visited in hospital by his manager "NATO" Wally Henderson and the NATO Powers (Straight Talk 11/15, msg_id 3_8kM9UzGxEJ).

caption: A wrestler whose on-air breakdown -- a chair-shot rampage, then vomiting live on television -- became a running autumn 1996 storyline.
